claim.claim-text: 1. A method for transmitting uplink data by a user equipment, UE, configured to operate in a wireless communication system, the method comprising:

2. The method of claim 1, wherein the information on the resource allocation includes information indicating a number of repetition of the PUSCH transmission, information indicating a start symbol of the PUSCH transmission, and information indicating a number of consecutive symbols from the start symbol allocated for the PUSCH transmission.
3. The method of claim 1, wherein the repetition of the PUSCH transmission is segmented based on the slot boundary or an invalid symbol which is the symbol to be dropped.
4. A user equipment, UE (2200), configured to operate in a wireless communication system, the UE (2200) comprising:
a transceiver (2203); and a processor (2201) configured to:

receive, via the transceiver (2203) from a base station, configuration information including information on resource allocation for physical uplink shared channel, PUSCH, transmission in a time domain, and information indicating a PUSCH repetition, identify, based on the configuration information, whether the UE (2200) is configured with the PUSCH repetition across slot boundary in consecutive slots, identify whether a symbol to be dropped for the PUSCH repetition exists among symbols in a slot, and in case that the UE is configured with the PUSCH repetition across the slot boundary in the consecutive slots, transmit, via the transceiver (2203), a repetition of the PUSCH transmission comprising a first part and a second part, wherein the first part of the repetition is allocated in a slot n and the second part of the repetition is allocated in slot n+1, wherein the repetition of the PUSCH transmission is performed in a unit of a number of symbols less than or equal to anumber of symbols constituting one slot, and wherein the symbol to be dropped includes a downlink symbol for downlink transmission.

5. The UE (2200) of claim 4, wherein the information on the resource allocation includes information indicating a number of repetition of the PUSCH transmission, information indicating a start symbol of the PUSCH transmission, and information indicating a number of consecutive symbols from the start symbol allocated for the PUSCH transmission.
6. The UE (2200) of claim 4, wherein the repetition of the PUSCH transmission is segmented based on the slot boundary or an invalid symbol which is the symbol to be dropped.
7. A method for receiving uplink data by a base station configured to operate in a wireless communication system, the method comprising:

8. The method of claim 7, wherein the information on the resource allocation includes information indicating a number of repetition of the PUSCH transmission, information indicating a start symbol of the PUSCH transmission, and information indicating a number of consecutive symbols from the start symbol allocated for the PUSCH transmission.
9. The method of claim 7, wherein the repetition of the PUSCH transmission is segmented based on the slot boundary or an invalid symbol which is the symbol to be dropped.
10. A base station (2300) configured to operate in a wireless communication system, the base station (2300) comprising:
a transceiver (2303); and a processor (2301) configured to:

transmit, via the transceiver (2303) to a user equipment, UE, configuration information including information on resource allocation for physical uplink shared channel, PUSCH, transmission in a time domain, and information indicating a PUSCH repetition, identify, based on the configuration information, whether the UE is configured with the PUSCH repetition across slot boundary in consecutive slots, identify whether a symbol to be dropped for the PUSCH repetition exists among symbols in a slot; and in case that the UE is configured with the PUSCH repetition across the slot boundary in the consecutive slots, receive, via the transceiver (2303), a repetition of the PUSCH transmission comprising a first part and a second part, wherein the first part of the repetition is allocated in a slot n and the second part of the repetition is allocated in slot n+1, wherein the repetition of the PUSCH transmission is configured in a unit of a number of symbols less than or equal to a number of symbols constituting one slot, and wherein the symbol to be dropped includes a downlink symbol for downlink transmission.

11. The base station (2300) of claim 10, wherein the information on the resource allocation includes information indicating a number of repetition of the PUSCH transmission, information indicating a start symbol of the PUSCH transmission, and information indicating a number of consecutive symbols from the start symbol allocated for the PUSCH transmission.
12. The base station (2300) of claim 10, wherein the repetition of the PUSCH transmission is segmented based on the slot boundary or an invalid symbol which is the symbol to be dropped.
